description: Coinbase fell ~7.1% close-to-close on 2026-06-05, capping a bruising crypto week - but the move was driven entirely by broad crypto-market conditions (Bitcoin crashing below $60,000, a wave of forced liquidations, and a 13th straight day of Bitcoin ETF outflows), not by any Coinbase-specific announcement. SEC EDGAR confirms Coinbase filed no 8-K in the surrounding window. This is the honesty-fallback stress test: the correct system behavior is to report 'no clear catalyst found' rather than inventing or misattributing a company-specific reason.

event.note: Sell-off began earlier in the week after Strategy (MicroStrategy) disclosed its first Bitcoin sale since 2022, triggering cascading forced liquidations (~$594M in 24h) and accelerating Bitcoin ETF outflows; a stronger-than-expected May jobs report added macro pressure on risk assets. None of this is Coinbase-company-specific.

trigger.verified_fact: Close-to-close decline of ~7.1% on 2026-06-05, from $164.13 (2026-06-04 close) to $152.40 (2026-06-05 close).
trigger.note: Real daily close prices sourced from Yahoo Finance. Comfortably trips a +/-3% move trigger.

no_catalyst_verification.method: Checked SEC EDGAR submissions history (CIK 0001679788, https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001679788.json) for the window 2026-05-15 to 2026-06-15.
no_catalyst_verification.result: No 8-K filed in this window. Only routine Form 4 (insider transactions), Form 144 (proposed sales of restricted securities), and one Schedule 13G/A (passive ownership disclosure) appear - none are material-event disclosures capable of explaining a price move.

ground_truth.one_line: COIN fell ~7.1% purely on broad crypto-market conditions (Bitcoin crash, forced liquidations, ETF outflows, macro rate pressure) - not any Coinbase-specific event. Correct behavior is to report 'no clear catalyst found'.
ground_truth.expected_citation: none - no company filing explains this move
ground_truth.naive_failure_mode: A weak system might retrieve an unrelated, stale Coinbase filing (e.g. a routine Form 4) or hallucinate a plausible-sounding company-specific reason for the drop. Correct behavior is to retrieve nothing relevant for this ticker/window and honestly report no catalyst.

provenance.sources: Price move and cause verified against contemporaneous financial press (TIKR, StockStory/FinancialContent) and cross-checked directly against SEC EDGAR's filing history for the ticker; daily closes sourced from Yahoo Finance.
